gaps.sentence: ___ honest answer would have saved everyone time.
The company is looking for ___ accredited supplier of packaging.
gaps.explanation: 'Accredited' begins with a vowel sound — 'an accredited supplier'.

gaps.sentence: It's ___ eight o'clock news — hurry up!
gaps.explanation: 'The eight o'clock news' — a specific, known programme.

gaps.sentence: He was wearing ___ strange metal bracelet on his left wrist.
gaps.explanation: 'A strange bracelet' (first mention); body parts after prepositions traditionally take 'the' (on the left wrist).

gaps.sentence: It's ___ one-way street, so you can't turn left here.
gaps.explanation: 'One' starts with /w/, a consonant sound, so 'a one-way street'.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best meal I've ever had.
He spent three years in ___ United States.
He considers himself ___ expert on medieval art.
gaps.explanation: 'An expert' — 'expert' starts with a vowel sound.
